name: Sydney
living: rainbow lorikeets flap across the sky now and then
the harbour water glitters in the low sun; the little sailboat drifts slowly
the Opera House sails catch a slow moving warm glint
the needle tower's turret lights glow and blink
city windows switch on one by one as the evening deepens
the golden clouds drift slowly across the teal sky (sky layer drift)
the light-tower lamp banks breathe gently
crowd shimmer in the stands, with camera flashes and a cheer pulse on a home run
note: fences in m at spray -45 (lf) / 0 (cf) / +45 (rf) deg, optional lcf / rcf at -22.5 / +22.5; wallHeight = the painted wall's height (m) at the fence (qa.py --wall-height); wallProfile (optional) = spray ranges where the painted wall is much taller/shorter; living = suggested living-painting details for this park (masks, sprites, shaders)
